title: Stay a Little Longer
style: Soft-rock power ballad with a slow, steady 6/8 sway; intimate piano and clean electric guitar open, warm bass and restrained drums enter gradually, broad melodic choruses with sustained guitar lines and subtle strings, then a quiet reflective outro. Male and female duet with conversational alternating verses, close harmonies that bloom in the chorus, expressive but controlled vocals, polished organic production and a cinematic dynamic build.
lyrics:
[Verse 1: Female]
You watched the last light gather on the hills
And asked me what I thought you’d left unsaid
You said they know the way your focus takes you
A new bright project, doors shut overhead

[Verse 2: Male]
I’m not the man for rebuilding forever
The duty and the upkeep dull the flame
I laughed, but there was something underneath it
A little hurt I couldn’t quite explain

[Pre-Chorus: Female]
I saw the names you carefully stepped around
I let the question rest between us there

[Chorus: Both]
Stay a little longer, tell me what you can
I can hear the truth beneath the careful plans
When the day goes quiet and the tide turns slow
You don’t have to name it all for me to know
Stay a little longer, let the silence breathe
There’s a softer road beneath the things we leave

[Verse 3: Male]
The waves kept folding over both our footprints
You smiled each time my stories changed their course
A wedding, old friends, a grin I couldn’t hide from
Then moonrise showed the path back to the door

[Verse 4: Female]
You said, put on your shoes before we wander
There might be little creatures on the way
I brushed the sand away inside the cabin
And wished the talk could carry through the day

[Pre-Chorus: Male]
I asked if you would rather eat here with me
Or take the tunnel to the house below

[Chorus: Both]
Stay a little longer, tell me what you can
I can hear the truth beneath the careful plans
When the day goes quiet and the tide turns slow
You don’t have to name it all for me to know
Stay a little longer, let the silence breathe
There’s a softer road beneath the things we leave

[Bridge: Female]
I wanted one more hour in that small room
To hear the thought you hadn’t found the words to say

[Bridge: Male]
You read the choice I couldn’t quite admit
And walked beside me anyway

[Final Chorus: Both]
Stay a little longer, tell me what you can
I can hear the truth beneath the careful plans
When the day goes quiet and the tide turns slow
You don’t have to name it all for me to know
Stay a little longer, let the silence breathe
There’s a softer road beneath the things we leave

[Outro: Both]
The moon kept watch above the path
And we walked on, side by side
